text.en:
The names of the Calumbuyan I Barrio School and Calumbuyan II Barrio School both in
Barangay Santa Ana, Municipality of Calatagan, Province of Batangas are changed to Pedro Palacio, Sr.
Memorial Barrio School I and Pedro Palacio, Sr. Memorial Barrio School II, respectively.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1984
